description: Managed Experiment Plan dashboard. Every query is permanently scoped to one AgentLoop Experiment Plan.

filters.sql: SELECT json_extract_scalar(data_link, '$.experiment_id') AS value, count(*) AS n WHERE json_extract_scalar(data_link, '$.experiment_id') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY value ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT json_extract_scalar(data_link, '$.experiment_version') AS value, count(*) AS n WHERE json_extract_scalar(data_link, '$.experiment_version') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY value ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT json_extract_scalar(data_link, '$.dataset_item_id') AS value, count(*) AS n WHERE json_extract_scalar(data_link, '$.dataset_item_id') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY value ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT evaluator_name AS value, count(*) AS n WHERE evaluator_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY value ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT json_extract_scalar(custom_outputs, '$.evaluator_version') AS value, count(*) AS n WHERE json_extract_scalar(custom_outputs, '$.evaluator_version') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY value ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT json_extract_scalar(custom_outputs, '$.rubric_id') AS value, count(*) AS n WHERE json_extract_scalar(custom_outputs, '$.rubric_id') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY value ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: 可比平均分
panels.sql: SELECT round(avg(coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value)) * 100, 2) AS comparable_avg_score FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1 AND status = 'success' AND coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value) IS NOT NULL

panels.title: 评分可用率
panels.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN status = 'success' AND coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS score_availability FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1

panels.title: 评估失败率
panels.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN status <> 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) AS failure_rate FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1

panels.title: 有效样本数 N
panels.sql: SELECT count(*) AS sample_count FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1 AND status = 'success' AND coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value) IS NOT NULL

panels.title: 平均分趋势
panels.sql: SELECT ${time_bucket} AS dt, round(avg(coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value)) * 100, 2) AS avg_score FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1 AND status = 'success' AND coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt

panels.title: 样本数趋势
panels.sql: SELECT ${time_bucket} AS dt, count(*) AS sample_count FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1 GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt

panels.title: 不同 Run / 版本对比
panels.sql: SELECT experiment_run_id, experiment_version, evaluator_name, coalesce(evaluator_version, 'legacy') AS evaluator_version, coalesce(rubric_id, 'unknown') AS rubric_id, round(avg(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value) END) * 100, 2) AS avg_score, count(*) AS total_n, sum(CASE WHEN status = 'success' AND coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scored_n, sum(CASE WHEN status <> 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_n FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1 GROUP BY experiment_run_id, experiment_version, evaluator_name, evaluator_version, rubric_id ORDER BY max(event_time_ms) DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: 主要问题分布
panels.sql: SELECT coalesce(primary_issue_category, 'unknown') AS category, count(*) AS value FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1 GROUP BY category ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: 低分与失败修复队列
panels.sql: SELECT from_unixtime(event_time_ms / 1000) AS event_time, experiment_run_id, experiment_version, dataset_item_id, evaluator_name, coalesce(evaluator_version, 'legacy') AS evaluator_version, rubric_id, round(coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value) * 100, 2) AS score, status, primary_issue_category, missing_point_count, conceptual_error_count, score_cap_count, improvement_suggestion, explanation, trace_id, eval_id FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1 AND (status <> 'success' OR coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value, 0) < 0.85) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status <> 'success' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value, -1), event_time_ms DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: 逐题评分明细
panels.sql: SELECT from_unixtime(event_time_ms / 1000) AS event_time, experiment_run_id, experiment_version, dataset_id, dataset_item_id, evaluator_name, coalesce(evaluator_version, 'legacy') AS evaluator_version, rubric_id, rubric_version, round(coalesce(normalized_score_value, score_value) * 100, 2) AS score, status, covered_point_count, missing_point_count, conceptual_error_count, score_cap_count, covered_points, missing_points, conceptual_errors, score_caps_applied, primary_issue_category, improvement_suggestion, explanation, trace_id, task_id, run_id, eval_id, custom_outputs_json FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1 ORDER BY event_time_ms DESC LIMIT 1000
